data.name: Batoolun
data.gender_notes: Batoolun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name for a girl derived from the Arabic word 'Bait' meaning 'house' and 'oolah' meaning 'promise'. The name signifies a girl who is a promise or blessing to her parents and loved ones. The name Batoolun carries the meaning “Daughter of the promise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Batoolun usually hope their child will grow to embody daughter of the promise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of loyalty and dedication, representing a strong bond with the divine
data.etymology: Batoolun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Daughter of the promise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Batoolun total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hindi.name: बटूलों
